families.mechanism: PIT Nasdaq constituent breadth may distinguish broad participation from a narrow QQQ price move
families.requires: Historical membership and actual completed constituent OHLCV with availability timestamps
families.reject: Survivorship/revised membership, absent timestamps, or fewer than20 changed events per development window

families.mechanism: Observed BTC cross-venue premium reconvergence may add information beyond a common spot return
families.requires: Actual synchronized exchange BTC/USD and BTC/USDT quotes, USD/USDT conversion and receipt clocks
families.reject: Assumed quote synchronization, missing stablecoin conversion, feed gaps treated as zero basis, or insufficient interventions

families.mechanism: An actual volatility term-structure state may condition price continuation without enlarging position risk
families.requires: Vintaged volatility-index/term-contract marks and actual release clocks
families.reject: Backfilled/revised index history, maturity lookahead, price-only alias, or inadequate changed-event support

families.mechanism: Newly finalized, timestamped on-chain exchange transfer shocks may identify BTC pressure beyond price/volume
families.requires: Historically vintaged address labels, block/publication/receipt times and transfer revisions
families.reject: Retroactive address labels, unknown publication latency, transfer/flow semantics not established, or inadequate support
